name: The Herald Reads the Terms
summary: The Born King's herald is here to read the terms of the combat. He has the pages in the wrong order.

stages.journal: The herald is reading the terms of the combat. The pages are out of order.
stages.hint: Help the herald, or ignore him.

stages.journal: We put the herald's pages in order, and he read the terms properly.
He read it all the wrong way round and nobody was any the wiser.

closes.warn: The herald will go when the Born King falls.
